title: KB3j: the (4,2) and (3,3) A-vanish walks - budget-honest partial with receipts; even-half self-sum profiles classified (outcome=partial; no new kappa)
body:
# KB3j: the (4,2)/(3,3) A-vanish walks and the even-half self-sum profiles - (4,2) walk partial with receipts, self-sum-bound lift DEMOTED (outcome=partial, no new kappa)

Contributor: **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance in scoping, implementation, verification and writing; no model named; no independent human review claimed). No kappa, supplier, certificate or selected-frontier change.

## Change and mathematical scope

In the PR943 prefix-walk model ([PR 943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/943)) a restored seven-source singleton word is universal exactly when its prefix set `P` covers: `P + P = F2^7`. The 17-point question is closed ([PR 2542](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2542), [PR 2634](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2634), [PR 2773](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2773), [PR 2870](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2870)); [PR 2911](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2911) narrowed the 18-point question to the splits (12,6), (11,7), (10,8), (9,9); [PR 2933](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2933) classified the vanishing configurations; [PR 2961](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2961) fully excluded (10,8); [PR 3023](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3023) killed (12,6) A-vanish (5,1) and reduced (4,2)/(3,3) to exact walkable forms; [PR 3034](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3034) demoted the parity shortcut and recorded the remainder this PR takes. This PR is strictly SET-level: no words are enumerated.

Record chain authors, all verified against current ground truth at writing with `gh pr view NNN --json author,title`: PR 2542/2634/2773/2870/2911/2933/2961/3023/3034 are Aaron Wang (navinor); [PR 2691](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2691) and [PR 2973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2973) are Nicholas Stone (NicholasStone); [PR 3005](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3005) is Nick Petalas (petalas); [PR 1185](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1185) is Mister-Meeseeks.

Concurrent word-level state, recorded honestly: PR 2973 (merged) records `22 <= f(7) <= 24` and PR 3005 corroborates it; PR 2973's own scope note records the set-level chain as unaffected. Under that gap this PR's question is the deciding necessary condition for `f(7) = 22`.

## Verdict per split (exact integers)

| Split | Status here | Deciding evidence |
|---|---|---|
| (12,6) A-vanish (4,2) | NOT decided (walk partial) | 29/2048 shards, 249,244,455 pairs, w_candidates=0 throughout; complete walk sized at 1.722e10 pairs, about 608 core-hours |
| (12,6) A-vanish (3,3) | NOT decided (no forced structure) | complete k=3 shape census: matched class (3,3) has 296,352 covers of 1,382,976 configs; 10 of 64 classes empty, killing at (I)/(II)/(III) or (IV)-only |
| (11,7) both-odd | NOT excluded (route c pressed) | m=3 both-odd self-sum profiles completely classified; self-sum-bound lift DEMOTED; frontier unchanged (E_o=13, min sum rho^2=17) |
| (9,9) both-odd | NOT excluded (route c pressed) | same route-(c) status; frontier unchanged (E_o=17, min sum rho^2=19) |
| construction | no 18-set found | no new search run; recorded ceilings 118/128 (PR 3034 run) and 119/128 (PR 2634 record) stand |

No class is decided here and nothing here excludes any class; the (4,2) zero counts are facts about walked pairs only.

## (4,2): exact reduction, validated engine, budget-honest partial walk

PR 3023's reduction extends: `D1 = {d1, d1+delta}` normalizes to `{0, 1}` (delta to 1 under `GL(5,2)`, `d1` absorbed by global translation). The class is EXACTLY the triples (U, V 6-sets, W 4-set) of `F2^5` with lines (a) `(U+W) u (V+D1)`, (b) `(U+D1) u (V+W)`, (c) `(U+V) u (W+D1)`, (d) selfsums of U, V, W, D1 each unioning to all of `F2^5`. The four lines are invariant under `(U+a, V+b, W+a+b)` and the mirror U/V swap (co-translation of each line's summands), so `0 in U, 0 in V` WLOG - machine-checked on 300 random configurations. Line (c) forces `M = F2^5 \ (U+V)` into `W u (W+1)`, so `|U+V| >= 24`; per pair a complete M-cluster W search decides the class exactly. PR 3023's budgets `|U+W| >= 20`, `|V+W| >= 20`, `|U+V| >= 24` hold.

Sizing (CHECKED): a 12-U probe walked 1,216,422 pairs in 154.6 s (7,866 pairs/s); the complete walk is 1.722e10 normalized pairs, about 608 core-hours at the measured rate. The complete decision is far outside one session, so the walk is recorded as a budget-honest PARTIAL with per-shard receipts (explicit `complete`/`budget_hit` flags, generous 3,600 s budgets, actual 1,411-1,583 s per shard):

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| shards complete of 2048 | 29 (all complete=true, budget_hit=false) |
| normalized U slices walked | 2,407 |
| normalized pairs walked | 249,244,455 |
| pairs with sumset 24 / 25 / 26 / 27 / 28 / 29 / 30 | 89,073,054 / 71,435,214 / 45,702,660 / 20,350,656 / 22,151,421 / 425,160 / 106,290 |
| W candidates passing (a),(b),(c) | 0 on every walked pair |
| covering configurations | 0 |
| core-seconds spent | 42,667.82 |

Recomputation proof (receipt-validation trap): shard 1 was re-run from an emptied receipt, its first run preserved; counters identical (83 U slices, 8,592,684 pairs, w_candidates=0, identical histogram; timing fields excluded).

The (5,1) kill shape is present on every walked pair (zero W candidates), but the (5,1) counting shortcut is DEMOTED for (4,2): (4,2)'s requirement window is 20-21 points per side against capacity 24, looser than (5,1)'s 26 against 30 with W forced to equal M. A structural contradiction is open (open question 2).

Small-space ground truth (PROVEN, complete): the k=3 census of the whole (4,2) shape has 576 classes, 484 with covers and 86 pair-killed - e.g. class (2,2,2) pair-killed, (2,2,3) line-(d)-only (32 candidates, all fail (d)), (2,2,4) with 80 covers of 322 candidates; the k=4 census (floor-surviving grid) has 96 classes, 10 with covers, 79 pair-killed. The shape is satisfiable at small scale, so the F2^5 zero counts cannot be a broken-machinery false empty.

## (3,3): complete small-space map, no forced structure

No singleton absorption exists; the four PR 2933 L3 lines apply directly with `0 in A0, 0 in A1` WLOG. The complete k=3 census (64 classes, 44,166,408 normalized configurations) maps the shape: matched class (3,3) has 296,352 covers; (2,3) and (3,2) are IV-only kills (2,688 / 6,048 configurations pass (I),(II),(III), none passes (IV)); eight small classes fail (I)/(II)/(III) outright; 10 of 64 classes empty in total. PR 3034's "no forced structure" is confirmed at the smallest scale: there is no small-instance contradiction to lift, and the class remains walk-ready but larger than (4,2).

## Route (c): even-half self-sum profiles at (11,7)/(9,9)

For a reduced covering pair (A, B) define the even-half multiplicity `mu2 = |(A+A) n (B+B)|`. Complete enumerations at the two testable scales (PROVEN):

| Scale | Split | Covers | Self-sum profile, all covers | Self-union |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| m=3 | (5,5) | 3,136 | (8,8,8) unique | 8/8 full |
| m=3 | (7,7) | 64 | (8,8,8) unique | 8/8 full |
| m=3 | (3,5) and (5,3) | 2,688 each | (4,8,4) and (8,4,4) unique | 8/8 |
| m=3 | (3,7) and (7,3) | 448 each | (4,8,4) and (8,4,4) unique | 8/8 |
| m=3 | (5,7) and (7,5) | 448 each | (8,8,8) unique | 8/8 |
| m=4 | (2,8) | 15,360 | (2,15,1) unique | 16/16 |
| m=4 | (4,6) | 143,360 | (4,13,4) x 35,840 and (7,16,4) x 107,520, mu2=4 all | 16/16 |

The m=4 (5,5) self-obstruction (PR 3034: 4,085,760 cross-covering pairs, self-when-cross 0, max self-union 15/16) is the quantified contrast: at m=3 every both-odd cover has FULL self-union and full selfsums at (5,5)/(7,7). The scale-dependent self-sum bound therefore does not lift - DEMOTED, exactly the failure PR 3034 predicted and now measured per profile.

What survives scaling (CHECKED at both scales): `mu2` is constant per split in every complete census here (m=3 all splits; m=4 (2,8) = 1, (4,6) = 4). This per-split constancy is the narrowed even-half condition to carry to the 501/196 surviving rows (PR 2911) before lifting to m=6. It is CHECKED at two scales, not proven at m=6, and no identity is claimed.

## Reproduce

Standard library only, CPython 3.12, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-av42-kb3j-b1/test_engine.py
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-av42-kb3j-b1/verify.py quick
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-av42-kb3j-b1/verify.py walks
```

Expected markers: `Ran 9 tests ... OK`, `PASS_KB3J_QUICK`, `PASS_KB3J_WALKS`. The test suite validates every engine against complete brute force on the smallest instances (all C(32,4) W 4-sets on sampled F2^5 pairs; all W subsets at m=3; pair walk against all normalized V; the reduction against direct coverage on every halved F2^3 configuration). The walk resumes with `run42.py av42 --shards 2048 --shard k --budget 3600` and `run42.py merge av42`; the censuses re-run with `run42.py k3` (196 s), `run42.py k4` (3,923 s) and `selfsum_classify.py`. Registered replay: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-18point-av42-kb3j-b1 --check-only` passes `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.

## Scope and limitations

Set-level only inside PR943's abstract interface. Not checked: anything word-level (PR 2973/PR 3005 hold `22 <= f(7) <= 24`; untouched here), walk-realizability of any cover, the (12,6) D-vanish classes, the surviving (10,8) classes, the 19-point question, and any kappa, supplier or selected-frontier implication. (4,2), (3,3), (11,7), (9,9) are all undecided here. The (4,2) walk covers 2,407 of 169,911 U slices (1.42%) and proves nothing beyond its walked pairs; the route-(c) profile facts are complete at m=3/m=4 only. All arithmetic is exact Python integers (int bitmasks); no floats are used. Frozen predecessor packages are unchanged; the ten pinned files are byte-exact with SHA-256 pins.

## Open next questions

1. **Complete the (4,2) walk** (resume from shard 29; about 605 core-hours remain at the measured rate; receipts make it deterministic and resumable). Blocked by: compute only. Clearing (4,2) forces any (12,6) A-vanish cover into (3,3).
2. **Isolate the w_candidates=0 mechanism** at `|U+V| = 24` (`|M| = 8`: W must be independent with `W u (W+1) = M` exactly, at most 16 candidates per pair). A pair-level contradiction would decide the class without the remaining walk. Blocked by: the (5,1) counting shape does not transfer; the mechanism is not isolated.
3. **Decide or identify (3,3)** via a new reduction (no singleton absorption) or a cross-line multiplicity identity coupling (I)/(II) with (III)/(IV). Blocked by: all four line budgets are slack; no forced structure at any scale tested.
4. **Lift the mu2 per-split constancy** to the 501/196 surviving rows (PR 2911) and then to m=6 as an exact even-half identity, or find where it breaks. Blocked by: constancy is CHECKED at two scales only; no cross/self coupling identity is known.
